upheld.reason: The consuming Statement explicitly requires the inner-boundary ratio limit for each fixed integer r>=0 and defines the same minimum distance to the lattice complement as the pressure supplier. F4 identifies that Statement convention before abbreviating it as every fixed r; Proof3.1 expressly matches the Statement boundary with F4 and applies the pressure theorem only to those stated van Hove sequences. No negative or noninteger boundary-width range is substituted for the supplier hypothesis.

The source Statement has two separately named models. Its N>=2 bound belongs to the periodic commuting Ising ring; the Global three-sector countermodel explicitly starts at N>=1 and gives exactly the partition and shell formulas restated in [F1]. The Example and Verification1.1–2.1 fix N=2 in that global branch, obtain Z_2=9/4 and middle probability1/9, and use the shell interval0<=Delta<2epsilon. Neither the F1 restatement nor either use widens the ring model.
